name: eaphammer
summary: Targeted evil twin attacks against WPA2-Enterprise networks. Indirect wireless pivots using hostile portal attacks.
highlights: --cert-wizard — Use this flag to run in Cert Wizard mode. Use "--cert- wizard create" to create a new cert
--list-templates — List available templates for the captive portal
--create-template — Create a template by cloaning a login page
--creds — Harvest EAP creds using evil twin attack
--pmkid — Perform clientless attack against PSK network using ZerBea's hcxtools.

flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: --debug
flags.description: Enable debug output.

flags.name: --cert-wizard
flags.description: Use this flag to run in Cert Wizard mode. Use "--cert- wizard create" to create a new certificate. Use "-- cert-wizard interactive" or simply "--cert-wizard" to run Cert Wizard in interactive mode. Use "--cert- wizard import" to import a set of certificates into eaphammer's static configuration. Use "--cert-wizard list" to list all previously imported certs, as well as the active cert configuration. Use "--cert-wizard dh" to manually regenerate eaphammer's dh parameters.

flags.name: --cloaking
flags.description: Send empty SSID in beacons and ignore probe request frames that do not specify full SSID (i.e. require stations to know SSID). Choices: [1. none - do not use SSID cloaking. ] [2. full - Send empty string in beacon and ignore probe requests for broadcast SSID ] [3. zeroes - Replace all characters in SSID with ASCII 0 and ignore probe requests for broadcast SSID.]
